reorganisation.verification: Official act title and enforcement date checked; effective 21 January 1972.

jaintia.verification: Indexed passage checked for orders dated 30 March 1835.

tripura.verification: Official indexed history checked for separate princely state and 1949/1956 integration sequence.

state1987.verification: Official account checked for statehood date; 1972 effective date follows the Reorganisation Act.

tripura-ncert.title: NCERT: Tripura protectorate, 1809
tripura-ncert.verification: Search-indexed NCERT passage checked: earlier British intervention, protectorate in 1809, recognition in 1838, and 1905 supervision. Full PDF fetch returned 502; the exact protectorate instrument was not inspected.

tripura-north.title: North Tripura: Political Agent, accession and merger
tripura-north.verification: Official full page read: agent in 1871; accession 13 August 1947; merger agreement 9 September 1949; administration transferred 15 October. The compressed 1761 statement is not used to annex all modern Tripura.

manipur-police.title: Manipur Police: 1891 and 1949 administration
manipur-police.verification: Official indexed passages checked: takeover on 27 April 1891, end of paramountcy in 1947 and integration in October 1949.

manipur-accession.title: Lok Sabha, 7 August 2024: Manipur accession date
manipur-accession.verification: Indexed parliamentary speech checked, printed p. 723: 11 August 1947 instrument and defence subject. The speech corroborates the date; it is not a facsimile of the instrument.

manipur-whitepaper.title: 1950 White Paper: Manipur merger, Article I
manipur-whitepaper.verification: Government White Paper transcription read: agreement signed 21 September 1949; transfer of administration 15 October 1949. Signature and effective date are distinct.

tripura-whitepaper.title: 1950 White Paper: Tripura merger, Article I
tripura-whitepaper.verification: Government White Paper transcription read: agreement signed 9 September 1949; transfer of administration 15 October 1949.

paramountcy-debate.title: Hansard, 22 June 1891: Manipur political relations
paramountcy-debate.verification: Contemporary official debate checked for recognition in 1826 and British claims of suzerainty. Distinguishes earlier political relations from the 1891 military settlement.

constitution-original.title: Constitution of India: original First Schedule
constitution-original.verification: Constitutional classification: Manipur and Tripura are Part C states under the Constitution from 26 January 1950; distinct from the 1949 transfer of administration.

nhta-act.title: 1957 Naga Hills–Tuensang Area Act, section 2
nhta-act.verification: Official indexed statutory text checked: new administrative unit IN the State of Assam, effective 1 December 1957. This is not full separation from Assam.

nagaland-act.title: 1962 State of Nagaland Act, section 3
nagaland-act.verification: Official indexed section 3 read: on the appointed day, NHTA ceases to form part of Assam. Statehood appointed day corroborated by Nagaland government: 1 December 1963.

mizo-state-act.title: State of Mizoram Act, appointed day
mizo-state-act.verification: Official indexed act commencement note checked: 20 February 1987; the Act was enacted in 1986.

arunachal-state-act.title: State of Arunachal Pradesh Act, 1986
arunachal-state-act.verification: Official Act and APPSC history identify Union Territory to state transition; appointed day corroborated as 20 February 1987.

meghalaya-autonomy.title: 1971 Census: Meghalaya autonomy and statehood
meghalaya-autonomy.verification: Official indexed jurisdiction passage read: autonomous state within Assam 2 April 1970; full state 21 January 1972, with Shillong exceptions.

sikkim-treaty.title: Lok Sabha, 1 April 1970: Sikkim protectorate treaty
sikkim-treaty.verification: Indexed official answer checked: Sikkim is a protectorate of India; treaty signed 5 December 1950. Protectorate is not full Indian statehood.

sikkim-state.title: PIB / Sikkim government: Statehood Day, 16 May 1975
sikkim-state.verification: Official indexed statehood account checked: former kingdom became India’s 22nd state on 16 May 1975. Date used is the officially celebrated statehood/admission date; not a referendum or legislative-passage date.

constitution-statehood.title: Constitution of India: commencement and First Schedule
constitution-statehood.verification: Assam is a constitutional state from 26 January 1950, continuing the earlier province. Manipur/Tripura Part C and later UT/statehood transitions are distinct.

ut-1956.title: Manipur Public Service Commission: central administration / UT
ut-1956.verification: Official institutional history checked for central administration through 31 October 1956; Union Territory phase begins 1 November 1956. Read with the constitutional reorganisation of Part C states.

sikkim-government.title: Government of Sikkim: 50 years of statehood
sikkim-government.verification: Official statehood site checked for separate kingdom and admission as the 22nd state in 1975.

gait.title: Gait (1906), A History of Assam, chs. III–V
gait.verification: Full public-domain text read; especially pp. 74–76, 84–90. Chronicle synthesis; colonial interpretations require caution.

gu.title: Gauhati University, History of Assam 1228–1826, Unit 2
gu.verification: Search-indexed passages verified; direct PDF currently returns 404. Conventional migration chronology and consolidation.

ignou.title: IGNOU, Unit 11: State Formation in the Northeast
ignou.verification: Search-indexed passage verified: Suteuphaa and the Namdang frontier; download unavailable.

nbu.title: NBU research, State in the Making: the Kamata-Koches, pp. 57–58, 68
nbu.verification: Full chapter downloaded/read. Research synthesis with references; early reigns and local traditions remain approximate.

neog.title: Neog (1977), epigraphic study, pp. 813–820
neog.verification: Bibliographic record and quoted inscription readings cross-checked through secondary citations; full article inaccessible in this session. Not a claim of direct plate inspection.

landgrants.title: NBU epigraphic research, land measures, p.177
landgrants.verification: Indexed research passage independently verifies the 1392 Dhenukhana and 1401 Ghilamara grants.

gazetteer.title: Arunachal Pradesh State Gazetteer: Tamreswari inscription
gazetteer.verification: Official gazetteer indexed inscription account: Mukta-dharmanarayana, Saka 1364/1442, temple enclosure wall.

shin.title: Shin (2020), Chutiya and Dimasa genealogical claims
shin.verification: Publisher record and scholarly quotations consulted; full text restricted. Discusses limits of founding genealogies.

nagaon.title: Census of India, Nagaon District Handbook, history
nagaon.verification: Official indexed passage: Sankardeva born into a Bhuyan family at Bardowa, 1449; local legends are not treated as dated conquests.

unesco.title: UNESCO: Charaideo and the Tai-Ahom first capital
unesco.verification: Official description read: 13th-century migration and Charaideo first capital; does not independently specify every stop/date.

migration-report.title: SITA Assam report, India–Southeast Asia connections, p.191
migration-report.verification: Indexed official report passage checked: Mong Mao, Hukawng, Patkai–Hukawng–Mogaung corridor. Direct download returned 404 in this session; it supports the broad corridor, not a surveyed track.

migration-phukan.title: Comprehensive History of Assam II, Tai-Ahom chapter: migration itinerary
migration-phukan.verification: Search-indexed book passage checked: 1215 Mong Mao departure; Wieng Maw opposite Myitkyina, Irrawaddy crossing, Soi-Ke, Mogaung, Nong Yang and Khamjang. Full volume not obtained; old muang identifications and detailed track remain unresolved.

migration-tai.title: Indian Journal of Tai Studies (2018): migration accounts
migration-tai.verification: Indexed journal passage checked: Mong Mao 1215, Upper Myanmar/Hukawng and Patkai. It proposes Wing Men may be Bhamo, differing from the Wieng Maw/Myitkyina identification; download returned 403. Bhamo is not pinned as an established Sukaphaa stop.

migration-nath.title: Nath & Tripathi (2024), Ancient Asia 15, p.84
migration-nath.verification: Open research article read: migration background places departure in 1215 and passage through Mong-Kwang and Patkai. It does not establish every bend or camp; its research focus is weapons.

migration-coordinates.title: GeoNames / modern locality references for Upper Myanmar
migration-coordinates.verification: Modern geographic placement only. Myitkyina/Waingmaw and Mogaung points cross-checked against current locality catalogues; coordinates do not establish medieval camp locations.

koch-foundation.title: University of North Bengal, Koch foundation research, printed pp.58–62
koch-foundation.verification: PDF text read, especially pp.58–62. Small inherited chiefdom, sequential campaigns, c.1515–1527 alternative chronology, capital traditions and mature borders; no year-specific intermediate boundary maps.

koch-campaigns.title: University of North Bengal, Naranarayan and state formation, chapter II
koch-campaigns.verification: Indexed excerpts checked; direct download timed out. Distinguishes tribute from annexation and discusses eastern wars and reverses.

koch-acharyya.title: N. N. Acharyya, History of Medieval Assam (1966), Koch chapter, p.189 onward
koch-acharyya.verification: Indexed p.189 checked: Chikna/Khuntaghat and successive neighbouring-chief campaigns. Direct download returned 403.

kachari-campaigns.title: Acharyya, History of Medieval Assam, Kachari chapter, pp.219 onward
kachari-campaigns.verification: Indexed text checked: December 1526 Dhansiri campaign and 1531 Marangi fighting; full direct scan remains inaccessible. 1532 is retained only as an approximate settled-map stage, not the first clash.

majuli-treaty.title: Treaty of Majuli: Nath (1989), p.58; Sarkar (1992), p.80, as cited in the treaty summary
majuli-treaty.verification: User-supplied treaty summary read: north-bank cession west of Subansiri, Koch overlordship, hostages and indemnity. Bibliographic citations identified; original book pages were not directly inspected in this revision.

mughal-bengal-karim.title: Abdul Karim, Banglapedia: Islam Khan Chisti
mughal-bengal-karim.verification: Article read: uneven earlier control, Dhaka in 1610, Bhati submissions in 1611, remaining Afghan/Sylhet resistance, and Kamrup campaign.

mughal-east-eaton.title: Richard M. Eaton (1993), The Rise of Mughal Power
mughal-east-eaton.verification: Publisher-hosted study read, especially the conquest and resistance passages: Dhubri siege, Parikshit, 1613 administration, and 1614–1615 revolts. It sometimes uses Kuch Bihar broadly; those passages do not justify painting the separate western successor state as directly annexed.

mughal-kamrup-nbu.title: University of North Bengal, western Assam formation, pp.94–96
mughal-kamrup-nbu.verification: PDF text read: eastern Koch core Sankosh–Barnadi and 1613 conquest. Source date differences are retained as a 1612–1613 campaign window.

mughal-chittagong.title: Jadunath Sarkar, History of Aurangzib III, Chittagong campaign
mughal-chittagong.verification: Indexed campaign passage checked: capture of Chittagong in January 1666. Full volume not downloaded in this revision.

mughal-rajmahal.title: V. A. Smith, Akbar the Great Mogul, Rajmahal campaign
mughal-rajmahal.verification: Indexed p.145 checked: Rajmahal, July 1576, and Daud’s defeat. Formal victory is not treated as immediate control of the eastern delta.

ahom-gait-frontiers.title: Gait (1906), History of Assam, pp.104–116, 125–129, 146–148, 160–161
ahom-gait-frontiers.verification: Public-domain PDF downloaded and relevant text read directly: Samdhara/tributary Darrang, November 1617 Pandu advance and failed Hajo attack, late-1630s campaigns and reverses, separate 1639 banks, 1658-context Guwahati capture, 1662 occupation, 1667 recovery and final 1682 settlement. Colonial synthesis is cross-checked; not all dates or channels are surveyed certainties.

ahom-guwahati-variants.title: Netaji Subhas Open University, Indian history study material: Guwahati/Kamrup chronology
ahom-guwahati-variants.verification: Indexed passage checked: March 1659 Guwahati and March 1660 wider Kamrup. These variants qualify the 1658 annual display anchor.

ahom-1667-kamrup.title: Kamrup district administration: Alaboi and Saraighat
ahom-1667-kamrup.verification: Official account checked: Lachit’s Guwahati recovery in 1667, followed by the later imperial counter-expedition.

kamauli.title: Venis, Kamauli grant, EI II pp.347–358
kamauli.note: Regnal year 4; CE conversions include 1123 and 1142. Original editor favoured 1142; appointment sequence firmer than absolute chronology.

vallabha.title: Kielhorn, Assam plates of Vallabhadeva, EI V pp.181–188
vallabha.note: Saka 1107, conventionally 1185; editor allows 1184/1185. Genealogy is not a dated reign list; father gives the command for the donation.

kanai.title: IGNCA, Assam Rock Art Report 2015, Kanai Barasi
kanai.note: 1206 inscription locality; no securely named defender in the inscription.

bakhtiyar.title: Banglapedia, Bakhtiyar Khalji
bakhtiyar.note: Disastrous Tibet expedition and return in 1206; no exact local battle route inferred.

iwaz.title: Banglapedia, Iwaz Khalji

gachtal.title: Assam Directorate of Archaeology, Gachtal site

gachtal-study.title: Madan-Kamdev historical study, chapter 2 p.50

prithu.title: N.K. Bhattasali, New Lights on the History of Assam (1946)
prithu.note: Prithu identification debated; consulted catalogue summary and contrasted scholarship; full primary text not freshly collated.

sandhya-dating.title: North Bengal University historical-geography thesis, chapter 1
sandhya-dating.note: Discusses the capital shift around 1260; older campaign dates differ. Do not make 1257 the certain moving day.

rajpat.title: ASI Kolkata, Rajpat excavation report, Site Location
rajpat.note: Rajpat at 26°09′N,89°21′12″E. Archaeological identification does not date Sandhya’s move.

kanai-gps.title: Ancient Asia 15 (2024), petroglyph locality table
kanai-gps.note: Kanai Boroshi Bowa 26°12′36.5″N,91°44′31.4″E. Rock-art site coordinate; not exact battle location.
